第28章 收钱-《我发现了世界BUG》

送走那个叫陈竹的女警之后，林舒始终处于一种心神不宁的状态。

一方面是他总觉得，对方似乎从自己跟她的对话中发现了什么东西。

比如漏洞？破绽？

另一方面，从陈竹跟自己的谈话中，他意识到，有关徐长顺的案件确实是有更高级别的力量介入的。

而那种“更高级别的力量”之所以要介入，无非就是因为两种可能性。

第一种可能性是，他们在徐长顺的死因里发现了异常。

第二种可能性是，他们在徐长顺的死亡过程里发现了异常。

无论哪种可能性，最终其实都是指向同一个隐喻，那就是.......

徐长顺的死，不是自然死亡。

他们一定会顺着这条线索继续调查下去，而林舒很确定，以这个国家官方机构的执行力，当行政命令的压力直接压下来时，为了破案，他们恐怕会连徐长顺坟边上的蚯蚓都挖出来带到审讯室问话。

更不要说自己了......

他们迟早是会找到自己、并且发现自己跟徐长顺的关联的。

他们也迟早会察觉到有关“仪轨”的一切。

到时候自己应该怎么做？

顺势而为，直接招安，还是硬抗到底，打死不认？

似乎都不是什么太好的选择.....

但现在也没别的办法了。

走一步看一步吧。

林舒无法可想，时间已晚，只有一件事情可做了。

睡觉！

或许是这几天太奔波、太劳累，虽然心里有很多事情，但一躺到床上，林舒还是迅速进入了睡眠。

他做了一个很长的梦。

这个梦从他见到徐长顺的那一刻开始，慢慢地发展到自己去参加他的葬礼、送他上山。

随后，自己取走了他的遗产、接受了他的传承，进行了第二次占卜。

当梦中的“占卜”开始时，林舒已经隐隐约约意识到了那是梦，但他没办法从梦里醒来。

他继续梦到了自己养成了蛇、抓到了厉雨、见到了陈竹。

这个时候，林舒的心里突然产了一个念头。

接下来再梦到的事情，那可就是没有发生的事情了。

它会像占卜一样......真的发生吗？

林舒甚至开始期待起来。

但也就在这个念头升起的同时，他醒过来了。

茫然睁眼，阳光已经从窗外透射进来。

林舒低声骂了一句“艹”，懊恼地爬起来。

实际上，在梦进展到“现在”，继续向未来推进之后，他确实还梦到了很多东西。

甚至，他还梦到了自己怎么跟那具昆尸扯上联系、又为什么要跑到厉雨的湘西老家去的。

只是可惜，在自己醒来之后，梦中的那些内容就好像烟雾一样飘散无踪了。

妈的......

After sending away the policewoman named Chen Zhu, Lin Shu was always in a state of uneasiness.

On the one hand, he always felt that the other party seemed to have discovered something from his conversation with her.

Like a loophole?flaw?

On the other hand, from Chen Zhu's conversation with himself, he realized that higher-level forces were indeed involved in the case involving Xu Changshun.

The reason why that "higher level power" wants to intervene is nothing more than two possibilities.

The first possibility is that they found an abnormality in the cause of Xu Changshun's death.

The second possibility is that they discovered anomalies in Xu Changshun's death process.

No matter which possibility, in the end it actually points to the same metaphor, that is...

Xu Changshun's death was not a natural death.

They will definitely continue to investigate along this clue, and Lin Shu is very sure that with the execution capabilities of this country's official agencies, when the pressure of administrative orders is directly suppressed, in order to solve the case, they may even dig out the earthworms next to Xu Changshun's grave and bring them to the interrogation room for questioning.

Not to mention myself...

Sooner or later, they will find themselves and their relationship with Xu Changshun.

Sooner or later, they will become aware of everything about "rituals".

What should you do then?

Should you go with the flow and directly recruit someone, or should you fight to the end and refuse to admit it until you die?

It doesn't seem like a good choice...

But now there is no other way.

Take it one step at a time.

Lin Shu couldn't think about anything. It was late and there was only one thing to do.

sleep!

Perhaps it was because he was too busy and tired these days. Although he had many things on his mind, Lin Shu quickly fell asleep as soon as he lay down on the bed.

He had a long dream.

This dream started from the moment he saw Xu Changshun, and slowly developed to attending his funeral and sending him up the mountain.

Later, I took away his inheritance, accepted his inheritance, and performed a second divination.

When the "divination" in the dream began, Lin Shu had vaguely realized that it was a dream, but he could not wake up from the dream.

He continued to dream about raising a snake, catching Li Yu, and meeting Chen Zhu.

At this time, Lin Shu suddenly had an idea in his mind.

The next thing you dream about has never happened.

Will it be like divination...will it really happen?

Lin Shu even began to look forward to it.

But just as this thought arose, he woke up.

I opened my eyes blankly, and the sunlight was already streaming in from the window.

Lin Shu cursed "fuck" in a low voice and got up in frustration.

In fact, after the dream progressed to the "present" and continued to the future, he did dream of many things.

He even dreamed about how he got connected with the corpse and why he went to Li Yu's hometown in western Hunan.

It's a pity that after I woke up, the contents of the dream drifted away like smoke without a trace.

Damn...
